items.title: Aaron Levie：封锁AI模型的策略不可行，中国已接近前沿水平
items.en_title: Gate keeping models will not work at scale. China can compete at near frontier levels.
items.full_text:
It's fairly obvious that gate keeping models will not work at scale.

Competing in AI is too economically and strategically important for China at this point, and we've now crossed the rubicon where it's clear that they can compete at near frontier levels. If this were even just 1 month ago and we saw kimi k3 our brains would be broken.

The solution to this isn't to get more locked down and slow your own ecosystem. If that happens, you can guarantee that America loses the global battle.
items.author: levie
items.summary: Box CEO Aaron Levie认为封锁AI模型的策略在规模上不可行。中国已能在接近前沿的水平竞争（如Kimi K3），更封闭只会让美国落后。
items.analysis: 这反映了硅谷对中国开源模型崛起的态度转变。对游戏行业而言，开源模型竞争力提升意味着AI游戏开发工具成本将持续下降。
items.recommendation: Box CEO：封锁AI模型不可行，中国已接近前沿

items.title: 模型层连续三年被称“将商品化”，但实际仍未商品化
items.en_title: 2024-2026: "The model layer is commodotizing." The model layer: still not commodotized.
items.full_text:
2024: "The model layer is commodotizing"
2025: "The model layer is commodotizing"
2026: "The model layer is commodotizing"

The model layer: still not commodotized.
items.author: mattturck
items.summary: 知名VC Matt Turck指出“模型层将商品化”的论调已连续三年未实现。前沿模型仍保持显著竞争优势。
items.analysis: 对游戏开发者：不要假设所有模型很快会一样好。选择哪个模型做AI功能仍是重要决策。
items.recommendation: 模型层三年“即将商品化”但始终未实现

items.title: Valve称内存危机远未结束：“老实说，情况还在变糟”
items.en_title: Valve says there's no end in sight to the memory crisis: 'Honestly, it's still getting worse'
items.full_text: Valve says there's no end in sight to the memory crisis: 'Honestly, it's still getting worse'
items.author: pcgamer
items.summary: Valve表示内存危机远未结束，甚至“情况还在变糟”。游戏内存需求持续增长而硬件供给跟不上。
items.analysis: 内存瘦身将成为未来游戏开发的硬性约束。对中小团队而言，内存优化能力可能成为竞争优势。
items.recommendation: Valve称内存危机持续恶化——游戏开发者面临更严格约束

items.title: ZA/UM新作口碑不佳后大规模裁员，粉丝：“他们毒害了这个品牌”
items.en_title: "They poisoned the brand" - Disco Elysium fans react as ZA/UM lays off staff weeks after Zero Parades launch
items.full_text: "They poisoned the brand" - Disco Elysium fans react strongly as controversy-laiden developer ZA/UM lays off a large chunk of staff, weeks after releasing Zero Parades: For Dead Spies to critical acclaim.
items.author: eurogamer
items.summary: ZA/UM（《极乐迪斯科》开发商）在新作Zero Parades发布仅数周后大规模裁员。粉丝反应强烈，称“他们毒害了这个品牌”。
items.analysis: ZA/UM警示：即使新作获媒体好评，商业表现不佳仍会导致裁员。口碑与销量的脱节是独立工作室的常见困境。
items.recommendation: ZA/UM新作口碑佳但销量差，发布数周即裁员
